fold5_availability.raw_gap_cause_limit: Saved source rows are missing or quarantined; this documentation does not establish an exchange outage or historical receipt times.

initial_split_eligibility.origin: Original data-only parent preflight; counts copied without fitting or new outcomes.

interpretation_limits: Required Spot features themselves create the entire fold5 hole; removing unused mask groups does not fix it.
Quarter regime labels describe pre-quarter history, not every subsequent bar.
The current constant-mean economic advantage is aggregate and fails the bear mean Alpha sign.
Fee and borrowing differences are not an additive causal decomposition of final equity differences because inventory paths differ.
Reused eight quarters do not establish prospective, selection-adjusted or trend-independent accuracy.
New availability or fallback policy, component shrinkage, and online bias procedures each require a fresh preregistered comparison before new outcomes.

mean_dynamic_component.aggregation: Each moment is computed on original paired score rows in each quarter, then quarters weighted equally; RMS is square root of equal-quarter second moment.
mean_dynamic_component.definition: delta = saved learned scaled mean minus saved scale_mean; anchor is actual mean of validation start minus6 through minus3 months. delta is centered on model scale-segment predictions, not on validation predictions.

scope: Post-outcome descriptive documentation of completed mean-controls and data availability diagnosis; no new model fitting, calibration procedure, policy targets or policy rollouts. Existing required causal feature computations only.
